note: Observed traffic counts for calibration (tools/demand.py -> SUMO routeSampler). One entry per counting point, direction and hour: lon/lat on the road, bearing = driving direction in degrees clockwise from north (null = any), hour = start of the hour (local time), vehicles_per_hour. Always fill source and date. Empty = uncalibrated synthetic demand. Kyiv detector data (КМДА / ЦОДР, 330 detectors) is not published as open data (checked 2026-09-19); request it as public information or copy published figures by hand.
